name: io.github.techfreakworm/kite-connect-mcp
title: Kite Connect MCP
description: Zerodha Kite Connect v3 for AI agents: orders (dry-run by default), GTT, alerts, portfolio, quotes

environmentVariables.name: KITE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key of your Kite Connect app (developers.kite.trade)

environmentVariables.name: KITE_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: API secret of your Kite Connect app, needed for the daily login (or use KITE_API_SECRET_FILE)

environmentVariables.name: KITE_MCP_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: managed (this server owns the daily login) or external (read a token file another program writes)

environmentVariables.name: KITE_MCP_TRADING_MODE
environmentVariables.description: dry_run (default: writes are only previewed) or live (writes need a confirmation token)

environmentVariables.name: KITE_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true hides every tool that can change the account
